solution: Put x = 2^a etc: 1/log2 x + 1/log3 x + 1/log4 x = log_x 2 + log_x 3 + log_x 4 = log_x 24. Set equal to 1 -> x = 24.
principle: 1/log_a x = log_x a. Sum of reciprocal logs = log of the product, base x.

text: GATE EC 2024 · Q12 · Control
solution: 20 dB/decade = 6 dB/octave (an octave is a factor 2, and 20log10(2) = 6). So 40 dB/decade = 12 dB/octave.
principle: dB/octave = dB/decade x log10(2) = dB/decade x 0.301.

text: GATE EC 2024 · Q13 · Control
solution: G(s) = 6/(s(s+1)(s+2)) is type-1, so the position error constant Kp = lim G(s) = infinity and steady-state error to a unit step is 1/(1+Kp) = 0.
principle: Type-1 + step input -> zero steady-state error. Type-0 + step -> 1/(1+Kp); ramp needs Kv.

text: GATE EC 2024 · Q27 · Digital
solution: Field widths: 24 registers -> 5 bits each, three register fields = 15 bits; opcode for 40 instructions = 6 bits. Immediate = 32 - 15 - 6 = 11 bits. Max unsigned value = 2^11 - 1 = 2047.
principle: Instruction encoding: bits left after opcode + register fields belong to the immediate. n bits unsigned -> 2^n - 1.
